videoBrief.prompt:
Imported screenplay: Breakfast — Bruno arrives

For the newly generated shot: animate the supplied doorway frame. Exactly ONE actual long-haired tricolor BERNESE MOUNTAIN DOG, BRUNO. Navy collar, broad white chest, adult male, same face as reference. No humans, no additional dog or puppy, no background figures, reflections or portraits. Heidi and Otto remain outside the framing. Fixed camera in the established wooden room, daylight from left. Do not redesign the room, open or close doors, or move furniture. Bruno speaks in a warm adult male baritone; the voice visibly originates from his synchronized canine muzzle. No narrator or female voice. Names in the line identify the addressee, not another speaker. No cuts, fades or dissolves inside this shot.

BRUNO: Morning, Grandmother.
